entry.author: ACC New Zealand
entry.summary:
When Alicia Mabey suffered an injury to her Achilles, she was worried about what that would mean for looking after her young family and running her business. But a positive mindset, following physio advice and being active in her recovery soon helped Alicia get back to her best.
